mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_link_access_stats ( full_short_url, gid, date, pv, uv, uip, hour, weekday, create_time, update_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{fullShortUrl}, #{gid}, #{date}, #{pv}, #{uv}, #{uip}, #{hour}, #{weekday}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pv = pv + VALUES(pv), uv = uv + VALUES(uv), uip = uip + VALUES(uip), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: select sum(uip) as uip,sum(uv) as uv,sum(pv) as pv,date,weekday from t_link_access_stats where full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} and gid = #{gid} and date between #{start} and #{end} and del_flag = 0 group by date,weekday
